metadata.prompt: Static frontal camera view: A 121g black ball is suspended high above a wooden plank, which is fixed on a black perforated optical table. Coefficient of friction is 0.81; coefficient of restitution is 0.58. When released, the ball undergoes free fall, followed by a sequence of successive bounces with diminishing peak heights, before finally coming to rest on the plank. The camera and the table stay still for the rest of the video. Maintain structural integrity and object consistency throughout: no changing shapes, no blending, and no flashing background.
